title.en: Room acoustics through first-reflection image sources

summary: Reveal direct and single-wall specular paths in a rectangular room, with travel delays rather than a claimed wave solution.
objective: Move source and receiver in three dimensions and inspect the wall reflection point and excess path length.
intent_signals: Move source and receiver in three dimensions and inspect the wall reflection point and excess path length.
Reveal direct and single-wall specular paths in a rectangular room, with travel delays rather than a claimed wave solution.
example_prompts: Build an explorable room acoustics through first-reflection image sources. Move source and receiver in three dimensions and inspect the wall reflection point and excess path length.

entities.name: Room and handles
entities.guidance: Build six rectangular planes at x=0,Lx; y=0,Ly; z=0,Lz, with z-up meters. Use an open inspection shell while keeping all six mathematical reflecting planes active. Separate source and receiver glyphs with distinct shapes.

entities.name: Image-source construction
entities.guidance: For selected wall n dot p=d with unit n, show mirror source S′=S-2*(n dot S-d)*n. Draw a dashed construction line from S′ to R, intersect the finite wall at Q, and draw the actual path S-Q-R distinctly.

entities.name: Arrival ruler
entities.guidance: List direct length |R-S| and each valid first-reflection length, plus geometric delay length/c0. Use one marker per path; equal arrival times remain ties rather than invented ordering.

state_contract.model: Choose L=(6,4,3)m, finite positive c0=343m/s as an authored uniform-medium value. Keep S,R strictly inside with a declared wall margin and |S-R|>epsilon. For each wall solve Q=S′+u*(R-S′), u=(d-n dot S′)/(n dot(R-S′)); accept u in[0,1] and Q in the finite wall rectangle within a scale-aware tolerance. Count direct plus six possible single-wall paths only.
state_contract.authority: Room dimensions, S,R,c0 and selected wall own path geometry and delay labels. Room hiding/cutaway changes visibility only. No audio, pressure amplitude, material absorption or wave state is inferred from path-line brightness.
actions: Drag source or receiver with numeric meter coordinates and reject boundary/outside placements.
Select a wall and expose its virtual source and reflection point.
Compare reflected delay and excess delay relative to direct arrival.
Animate an illustrative pulse at chosen slowed playback speed along the computed paths, pause, and reset dimensions, points, speed and pulse clock.

invariants: For each accepted path, |S-Q|+|Q-R| equals |S′-R| within geometric tolerance and is no shorter than direct length.
Q lies on its declared wall and within its finite rectangle; incoming and outgoing unit directions have matching tangential components and opposite normal components.
Swapping source and receiver preserves path lengths in this reciprocal static geometry; coincident arrivals stay tied.
motion_guidance: Use accumulated traveled length along segments to place pulse glyphs; display any time slowdown factor. A moving dot is a propagation illustration, not sampled sound pressure.
Parameter edits recompute paths and restart the pulse clock rather than mixing segments from old and new rooms.
known_limits: First-order geometrical paths only: no diffraction, scattering, occlusion by furniture, modal field, phase interference, pressure level, absorption calibration or reverberation-time prediction.
A hidden wall remains a reflector in inspection mode. Removing a reflector would be a separate model edit; the six-path count does not generalize to rooms with openings or obstacles.
Authored recipe and prospective checks only; no runtime artifact or rendered result has been observed.

claims.statement: The TU Eindhoven image-source teaching example constructs first-order reflection paths by mirroring a source across a room boundary and intersecting the line from the image to the receiver with the finite wall; its visualization separates construction lines from reflected paths.
claims.scope: Institutional planar mirror-construction example; recipe extends elementary reflection geometry to six axis-aligned planes, without adopting its reverberation exercise.

source_refs.locator: draw_reflection_paths, _draw_first_order and mirrored coordinates; Room description and Image source visualization

object_craft.family: Room acoustics through first-reflection image sources
object_craft.structure: Keep mathematical wall planes independent of visible wall thickness, source furniture and decorative panels. Reflection markers attach to the plane, not the outer face of an arbitrary display shell.
object_craft.material: Use independent line weights, shapes and labels for mathematical roles. Color and surface finish are presentation choices; do not infer material physics from them.

creative_affordances: A dollhouse cutaway, transparent room or wireframe studio can expose vertical ceiling/floor paths. Different path colors and arrival labels may aid comparison without encoding unsupported acoustic strength.

physical_contract.scope: Derived mathematical geometry and authored inspection; no contact dynamics or calibrated physical artifact.
checks: For each accepted path, |S-Q|+|Q-R| equals |S′-R| within geometric tolerance and is no shorter than direct length.
Q lies on its declared wall and within its finite rectangle; incoming and outgoing unit directions have matching tangential components and opposite normal components.
